related.description: The official source code repository for the calibre ebook manager
Calibre-Web but Automated and with tons of New Features! Fully automate and simplify your eBook set up!
Drop e-books and comics into a folder, get Kobo/Kindle-ready files out. kepubify + KCC with a WebUI, in one Docker image.
:books: Find your next book to read!
This is an MCP server used for querying books, and it can be applied in common MCP clients, such as Cherry Studio.
